scientific_integrity: The all-length result follows from a bijective greedy-embedding cost proof and formal-series identities. Finite checks supplement but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for prefixes of the alternating binary word only; does not prove any global extremal binary-word property. Equivalence in unindexed earlier literature remains possible.
title: Exact Fibonacci spectra for scattered palindromes of alternating binary words
